keyPhrases.text: I'm no great fan of this stratagem
calibrated each of those 100 minutes to strike a nerve
has more urgency than the Broadway original
this production will stay with me as few others

reasoning: Despite criticisms of Pinter's reverse chronology structure and dramatic letdown, the review is overwhelmingly positive about performances ('superb,' 'extraordinary') and Nichols' direction. The explicit 5-star rating and statement that it will 'stay with me as few others' confirms strong recommendation despite reservations about the play's structure.
